claimed_root_cause: loginWithPassword persists the raw password in expo-secure-store using AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK rather than a ThisDeviceOnly accessibility class or a refresh token, and app.json neither disables Android allowBackup nor pins SecureStore backup rules.
title: Remembered staff password stored in backup-eligible SecureStore
description: A backup or other-OS-profile restorer—not another app on the live profile—may recover the reusable Estate-EZ password. Each mobile sign-in writes email+password under ct_mobile_login_credentials with iOS AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK and without requireAuthentication. That item can mint a new staff JWT via silent re-login. Same-app use on the signed-in OS user is out of scope.

trace.description: After POST /auth/login, the app writes JSON {email, password} to SecureStore key ct_mobile_login_credentials with no remember-me flag.
All secureSet calls, including the password, use AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK and do not set requireAuthentication or a ThisDeviceOnly constant.
The password string is stored in the OS keychain/keystore-backed store. Boot and silentRefresh later read it with getItemAsync(key) and call login again.

validation_plan.local: On an isolated simulator/emulator with a dummy tenant, sign in, then read the written item's iOS accessibility class and Android backup XML/EncryptedSharedPreferences binding. Restore an encrypted backup onto a second dummy device or profile and see whether the dummy password silently logs in. Do not use live staff accounts.
validation_plan.deployment: Owner inspects the EAS production APK/IPA AndroidManifest allowBackup and expo-secure-store backup rules, and the iOS keychain accessibility for com.caringtransitions.capture. Do not export or replay live staff passwords.

blockers: OS-enforced sandbox and parent artifact promotion unavailable (empty allowlist env, no-network namespace, read-only target, trusted parent-side no-follow promotion); target code was not executed
No android/ or ios/ trees; EAS merged AndroidManifest allowBackup plus SecureStore backup XML, and the shipped IPA keychain accessibility, are packaging facts
Encrypted iCloud/Finder/Google/MDM backup restore of dummy ct_mobile_login_credentials onto a second dummy device or OS profile was not observed

evidence.description: CREDENTIALS_KEY is ct_mobile_login_credentials, documented as email+password for silent re-login when the JWT expires.
Stored value is JSON.stringify({ email, password }) of the staff password, not a refresh token.
keychainAccessible is AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK, which is backup-eligible on iOS; AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK_THIS_DEVICE_ONLY is not used.
secureGet calls getItemAsync(key) with no requireAuthentication options.
android package com.caringtransitions.capture sets no allowBackup false and no backup/dataExtraction rules.
plugins includes expo-secure-store as a string with no configureAndroidBackup object.
